title: Practice 6: в лесу, на берегу: the stressed -у

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: It's dangerous to jump off a moving train.
exercises.why: Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions в or на. The same nouns have the regular ending -е after о, об. *Я был в лесу, в саду, в аэропорту, на берегу.* Also: на мосту, в полку, в or на снегу. However: *Я говорю о лесе, об аэропорте. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 27.  ·  «Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions В or НА. The same nouns have the regular ending -е after О, ОБ.» — DLI, Lesson 27.
exercises.context: Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 27)
